text:
Renee (PM): Quick design feedback on evals Run page. Two pain points: long regression diffs push scorecard out of view and keyboard bulk-select is hard to discover. Posted a quick mock.

Hugo (Designer): Mock uploaded. Plan: compact list with inline expand, persistent left filter rail, and a small inline score legend (info icon) instead of a separate panel.

Marta (Frontend): Inline expand + virtualization = preserve expanded ids in memory. Keyboard shortcuts: Enter to open, Space to toggle, Shift+Arrow for range select, and 'f' to focus filters.

Omar (Eng): Backend: bulk-approve returns undo_token and undo_window_ms. Undo should enqueue a reversal job; make bulk ops idempotent.

June (A11y): A11y notes: 1) Make the info icon keyboard-focusable with aria-describedby. 2) When expanding a diff, move focus into the content or expose a skip link. 3) Ensure contrast for score chips >=4.5:1.

Renee (PM): Decision: implement compact mode toggle (persisted), inline expand, keyboard range select, bulk approve modal with undo copy: "Approve 5 evaluations — marked accepted for Run #981. Undo available for 5 minutes." Hugo will update mocks. Sync Monday to sign off.

Hugo (Designer): Updating Figma and adding keyboard hint tooltip.

Marta (Frontend): I'll start feature branch for keyboard + expanded-state handling.

Omar (Eng): I'll open infra ticket for undo pipeline and idempotency.

June (A11y): I'll produce a short QA script for screen readers and post to the PR.
